paper_title: Distilling Empathy from Large Language Models
caption: GPT-4o vs. Fine-tuned LLaMA & Mistral in empathetic responses as judged by Gemini
model_annotation: The chart is a donut chart showing the win rate percentages for empathetic responses of different models. The chart compares four different models, dividing them into four slices. The slices represent LLaMA (light blue) at approximately 80.4%, Mistral (beige) at around 88.0%, GPT-4o (dark blue) at 12.0%, and another GPT-4o (light blue) at 19.6%. Each slice is labeled with its corresponding model name and percentage. The chart is labeled "Win rate (%)" in the center. The segments are not in any particular order, and there is no visual emphasis on any slice. The chart provides a visual representation of the relative win rates of the different models, with the labels placed outside the chart and connected to their corresponding slices with lines.
